# metal_tankard — realism QA

Evidence: f0403, f0321, f0305. Fixed calibrated cameras and common instance pose. Mean visible IoU 0.843; worst 0.815; RGB histogram intersection 0.720. Review: `../review/metal_tankard_compare.jpg`.

Grades: silhouette B, proportions A, colour_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B.

- Replaced generic wire grip and beads with curled cast bird neck, tapered wing, feather ribs and lower support.
- Reconstructed irregular gilt rim crest and wider stepped support foot.
- Added reference-conditioned architectural engraving bump texture.
- Refit one common world pose and shape scale against three calibrated views.
- Corrected engraving UV height and seam; baked portable base-color/tangent-normal maps and kept the inner wall, rim and handle plain metal.
- Round 2: replaced generated engraving with calibrated photo-projected fine relief and neutral silver fallback on the unseen back; reduced excessive normal amplitude.
- Round 2: refined common pose and scale against all three source masks.
- Added three calibrated evidence views, source-only manual masks, numeric IoU and masked RGB histogram comparisons.
- Added physics mass/density/friction/restitution/COM/fragility metadata with uncertainty and synchronized native rigid bodies.

Remaining:
- Fine photographed engraving is transferred only over the visible hemisphere; the unseen back, heraldic detail, alloy and product identity remain unresolved.
- Product identity and actual weighed mass are unverified; physics parameters are explicitly estimated.

Mass is an engineering prior, not the real product weight. `physics` includes the shell-area check, density, 40% mass uncertainty, per-body COM and contact coefficients. No deformable item is present in this set.

Per-view bounding dimensions and three projected width samples are measured in source pixels. Rim wall thickness, hidden hinge internals and unreadable markings cannot be resolved to physical accuracy from these images; nominal values are not photo measurements.

Previous notes are archived in `../review/before/metal_tankard/notes.md`; current geometry, poses and physical properties are authoritative in `model.json`. GLB contains visuals; load the JSON joints/collision mapping for simulation.
